text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s10.e20","problem":"Left card photo (the woman with pearls) is drawn offset and slightly the wrong size. A tan strip shows at the right edge and the top is cropped differently. The heatmap shows red bleeding around the blue-masked area.","fix":"Draw assets/s10.e20.art.png at exactly x=24.0, y=177.6, w=156.9, h=188.1 with object-fit:fill. Remove any background or extra border or padding, and make sure nothing is stacked on top of it."},{"element_id":"s10.e39","problem":"The Hot Day chibi image is offset, and a light gray band shows at its right side and top.","fix":"Place assets/s10.e39.art.png at x=218.7, y=174.1, w=150.8, h=188.1, with no margin, padding or gray background behind it. Fill the surrounding card area with the dark purple card color."},{"element_id":"s11","problem":"Card art shows tan and gray strips beside the images, and the pager buttons are red on the heatmap. The sparkle glyphs are larger and brighter than the real ones. Card tag emoji render differently.","fix":"Draw assets/s11.e20.art.png at x=24, y=174.1, w=159.2, h=188.1 and assets/s11.e23.art.png at x=218.7, y=174.1, w=151.2, h=188.1. Draw assets/s11.e77.art.png at x=319.7, y=773.4, w=50.2, h=60.8. Shrink the sparkles by about 15%. Make the prev and next pager buttons a flat #2c2f33 with a thin border, and give the card text the same weight as the real screen."},{"element_id":"s10","problem":"Emoji in the tags (Male, Anime, Multiple, AnyPOV, Female) use a different emoji font. The message-count icon in the cards' top-right badge is a flag-like glyph instead of the real speech-bubble icon. Card body text renders about 1px off.","fix":"Replace the badge glyph with a small outlined double-bubble icon, and use the same emoji glyphs as the real screen at 11px. Use the card body text 13px, line-height 16px, weight 400. Shift the header text down about 1px."},{"element_id":"s18","problem":"Text is bolder and about 2px wider than the real screen. Names sit 1px too low. The 'Start new chat' label has a broken glyph, and the button border shows tick marks from the overlaid nav-asset boundaries. The action icon color is off.","fix":"Set the name text to 16px weight 500 and shift it up 1px. Remove the overlaid asset tiles from the bottom button. Draw the label as plain text 'Start new chat', 15px weight 600, color #b48cf0, with a 2px #6b5a8f border, radius 12px. Make the message preview text 13px."},{"element_id":"s18.e09","problem":"The header and list avatar photo edges differ slightly and the red border shows on the heatmap.","fix":"Draw assets/s18.e09.art.png at x=6.5, y=191.7, w=71.6, h=73.8 with a 12px rounded clip. Make the header avatar the same photo at 58px, clipped to a 12px radius, at x=11, y=71."}],"summary":"All elements are placed within tolerance and there are no failed taps or contract errors. The remaining loss is SSIM: card art offsets, fonts, and emoji and icon glyphs. This round should align the card art exactly at its rects, fix the badge icons and emoji, and tidy the bottom button on s18."}
